author: SALTO Participation & Information
title: Open call for illustrator - participation and democracy illustrations
content: 🎨 Calling all artists and illustrators: Help bring participation and democracy to life! SALTO Participation & Information is looking for an illustrator, artist, or illustration-led organisation to create a collection of approximately 10–15 original illustrations inspired by participation, democracy, active citizenship, inclusion, critical thinking, community, cooperation, access to information, and having a voice. The illustrations will primarily become a series of fun and engaging stickers shared across the SALTO PI community. Open to illustrators worldwide. Fee: €1,500 for the full assignment. Approximately 10–15 original illustrations. Application deadline: 8 November 2026. Final illustrations completed by 18 December 2026. No Generative AI. Applications should include a short professional profile, selected portfolio, brief creative direction, and one example or early concept. Find the full call and application details on our website or link in bio. Contact: link in bio / website.
